newsitem.title: USA: Bankers to buy NationsBank trust business - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Bankers to buy NationsBank trust business - WSJ.

text.p: Bankers Trust New York is expected to announce plans on Friday to acquire NationsBank Corp's institutional trust business, the Wall Street Journal said in its electronic edition.
Terms of the deal, which would boost Bankers Trust's assets under custody to almost $2 trillion, were not available, the newspaper said on Friday.

The Journal quoted Bankers Trust officials as saying the acquisition would not have a meaningful impact on the company's earnings. The transaction was due to close in the second quarter, the paper said.
On April 22, the Bank of New York said it signed a definitive agreement to buy the corporate trust business of the former Boatmen's Bancshares from NationsBank.
Neither Bankers nor NationsBank were immediately available to comment on the report.
